title: OWNER_PHASE_APPROVAL v3 -- the DETACHED Gate 1B EXECUTION approval
description: v3 (GATE 1A.2 section 2B). A DETACHED owner-controlled file: it is NEVER committed into the source commit it authorizes (self-reference); the campaign receipt records its SHA-256 instead, and tools/verify_phase_approval.py refuses an approval file found inside the package tree. It authorizes the claim-bearing campaign ONLY after container prep has resolved every execution identity -- nothing is deferred past this signature. The verifier takes NO key material: the owner public key comes only from the trust root trust/OWNER_PUBLIC_KEY_PIN.json (production) and the record's owner_key_id must match the pin. Canonical signing bytes: UTF-8 of json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(',', ':')) with ed25519_signature set to the empty string.

execution_code_commit_sha.description: must equal package_commit_sha AND the exact checked-out commit

gate1a2_execution_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of GATE1A2_EXECUTION_MANIFEST.json -- every source, schema, test, container recipe, infrastructure file, and dependency lock used by the campaign

container_prep_receipt_sha256.description: sha256 of CONTAINER_PREP_RECEIPT.json produced under the CONTAINER_PREP approval; the verifier recomputes it from the receipt file

run_schedule_sha256.description: sha256 of RUN_SCHEDULE_MANIFEST_CANDIDATE.json -- the expected receipt set is DERIVED from this signed schedule, never hardcoded

claim_bearing_seeds.description: exactly ONE frozen seed list (3 or 5 seeds -- the owner decision); the code supports both, the approval binds one

salted_protected_manifest_sha256.description: 64-hex iff the salt derivation is chosen (a separately generated salted protected manifest, never compared with the public-seed digest); the literal NOT_APPLICABLE_PUBLIC_SEED otherwise

max_hourly_rate_usd.description: the signed rate ceiling; the launcher accepts NO --hourly-rate argument

owner_key_id.description: must equal the trust-root pin's key_id; TEST- ids are refused in production
